t: A 20-minute paper module that turns a hand-built language model into an agent.
steps: Find the LLMs Unplugged site and open the modules page.
Run the Training and Generation modules first.
Open the Agentic AI module page.
Print the sheets or cutouts from the site.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Choose the people who will answer the text messages.
Agree on how replies will be sent. The vendor does not say which tools to use.
